# Pick n Edge · Metrics

Every metric is defined once in `scripts/metrics/registry.mjs`. Ratios are `Σ numerator ÷ Σ denominator` over the games of the window (Season, last 3/5/10 team games), never an average of per-game ratios.

**Naming.** `/100` = count × 100 ÷ possessions while on court: offense stats (PTS, AST, TOV, OREB, FD) per 100 team offensive possessions, defense stats (STL, BLK, DREB) per 100 team defensive possessions; REB/100 combines both phases (× 200 ÷ (offensive + defensive possessions)). `%` = part of a defined whole. No suffix = per game or per minute, as stated in the label. Team turnovers are "TOV/100", never "TOV%".

**Components.** Player rows: `data/clean/player_games.csv`. Team rows: `team_games.csv`, with the opponent's figures as `o_<column>`. Derived components: `pts` = m1 + 2·m2 + 3·m3; `o_pts` = o_m1 + 2·o_m2 + 3·o_m3; `misses` = a1 − m1 + a2 − m2 + a3 − m3; `reb` = oreb + dreb; `fga` = a2 + a3; `fgm` = m2 + m3; `o_fga` = o_a2 + o_a3; `used` = sa + tov; `team_used_on` = team_sa_on + team_tov_on; `net` = pts − misses − tov; `nonscoring` = oreb + dreb + ast + stl + blk + fd − pf − blk_against − tov; `pir` = net + nonscoring + tov; `zs_rim_a` = z_rim_a; `zs_paint_a` = z_paint_a; `zs_mid_a` = z_midL_a + z_midC_a + z_midR_a; `zs_base_a` = z_baseL_a + z_baseR_a; `zs_arc_a` = z_arcL_a + z_arcC_a + z_arcR_a; `zs_corner_a` = z_cornerL_a + z_cornerR_a; `zm_3p_a` = z_arcL_a + z_arcC_a + z_arcR_a + z_cornerL_a + z_cornerR_a;
